answer: Because the gale decay is applied at each close, the velvet audit publishes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 11% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the ridge fee to keep them eligible. A 97 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
